module_summary: RISC-V DIV/DIVU/REM/REMU unit: decodes opcode, runs a 32-cycle restoring shift-subtract division with sign fixup, and caches last operands to skip repeated operations.

anchors.name: opcode_valid_i
anchors.why: Issue valid; with divide decode forms div_start_w.

anchors.name: opcode_opcode_i
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded into div/divu/rem/remu flags.

anchors.name: opcode_ra_operand_i
anchors.why: Dividend operand, sign-corrected into dividend_q.

anchors.name: opcode_rb_operand_i
anchors.why: Divisor operand, sign-corrected and shifted into divisor_q.

anchors.name: writeback_valid_o
anchors.why: Result valid pulse driven by valid_q after completion.

anchors.name: writeback_value_o
anchors.why: Quotient or remainder result from wb_result_q.

anchors.name: inst_div_w
anchors.why: Decoded DIV instruction; divu/rem/remu flags are siblings.

anchors.name: div_rem_inst_w
anchors.why: Any divide/remainder opcode, qualifies div_start_w.

anchors.name: signed_operation_w
anchors.why: Signed op flag selecting operand negation on load.

anchors.name: div_start_w
anchors.why: Start strobe loading operands, mask and busy flag.

anchors.name: div_complete_w
anchors.why: Completion when q_mask exhausted; clears busy, loads result.

anchors.name: div_busy_q
anchors.why: Busy state enabling iterative shift-subtract steps.

anchors.name: dividend_q
anchors.why: Running remainder, reduced by divisor each successful step.

anchors.name: divisor_q
anchors.why: Shifted divisor compared and subtracted each iteration.

anchors.name: quotient_q
anchors.why: Accumulates quotient bits from q_mask_q.

anchors.name: q_mask_q
anchors.why: One-hot bit position shifting right; empty mask ends division.

anchors.name: invert_res_q
anchors.why: Sign fixup flag negating final quotient or remainder.

anchors.name: div_inst_q
anchors.why: Selects quotient versus remainder for result.

anchors.name: div_result_r
anchors.why: Sign-corrected quotient/remainder selected for writeback.

anchors.name: wb_result_q
anchors.why: Registered result captured on completion, drives writeback value.

anchors.name: last_a_q
anchors.why: Cached last operand A for repeat-operation detection.

groups.name: Opcode decode
groups.description: Decodes divide/remainder variants and signedness from opcode.

groups.name: Divider control
groups.description: Start, busy and mask-driven completion of iterative divide.

groups.name: Shift-subtract datapath
groups.description: Restoring division registers and sign-corrected result select.

groups.name: Result cache
groups.description: Last operands and op flags to reuse previous result.

groups.name: Writeback
groups.description: Registers result and valid pulse to writeback port.
